components.name: Search Field
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;width:320px;height:40px;padding:0 10px 0 12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #cdd0ca;border-radius:4px}.ds-search:focus-within{border-color:#1d2024;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(29,32,36,.1)}.ds-search input{flex:1;border:0;outline:0;font:15px 'Hanken Grotesk',sans-serif}.ds-search kbd{font:600 12px sans-serif;color:#62676f;border:1px solid #cdd0ca;border-radius:3px;padding:3px 6px}

components.name: Late Mark
components.description: Late or over-limit: words plus a screen-tint hatch.

narrative.overview: Every app is a page from a printer's ink swatch book: each app owns one process ink, and every status the business tracks is a labelled swatch you can pick up.
keyCharacteristics: White chip stock on a cool desk
Fits one screen on a computer

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: An app's ink appears as fields, never as text.

rules.name: The Labelled Swatch Rule
rules.body: A swatch always carries its name and figure.

rules.name: The Second Cue Rule
rules.body: Late and over-limit states carry words plus a hatch mark.

rules.name: The Weight Rule
rules.body: Rank comes from weight and size, never all-caps labels.

dos: Totals add up to the rows beneath
Keep DPR statuses in order and labelled
donts: No eyebrows, gradient text or glass
